title: Worker Capsule
description: Defines the isolation boundary and operational contract for a single Builder agent spawned by the Orchestrator. Every Builder MUST receive a valid worker capsule before beginning work.

capsuleId.description: Globally unique identifier for this capsule instance. Format: capsule-{phase}-{agentId}-{timestamp}.

phase.description: The factory phase this capsule belongs to (e.g., FACTORY-AGENT-1, FACTORY-AGENT-2).

agentId.description: The unique agent identifier assigned to this worker.

role.description: Functional role of the agent (e.g., SCHEMAS-PROTOCOLS, STARTER-KIT, BLUEPRINT-DESIGN).

forkContext.description: MUST be false. Forking context is forbidden in the factory-agent model; every agent starts from a clean capsule.

ownedScope.description: List of filesystem paths this agent is authorized to read and write. All output MUST fall within these paths.

forbiddenScope.description: List of filesystem paths this agent MUST NOT touch. Violation triggers quarantine and escalation.

allowedImports.description: Approved dependencies, modules, and protocols the agent may use.

forbiddenImports.description: Explicitly disallowed imports. Attempting to use any triggers contract violation.

expectedOutputs.description: Concrete deliverables the agent must produce. Every item must exist at handoff time.

path.description: Relative path within ownedScope to the deliverable.

description.description: Human-readable description of what this deliverable must contain.

requiredEvidence.description: List of evidence types the agent MUST produce to prove work was genuinely done.

fileList.description: MUST be true. Handoff must include a complete file manifest.

sha256.description: MUST be true. Every file in handoff must include a SHA256 checksum.

transcriptRef.description: MUST be true. A transcript reference proving agent activity must be included.

contractChecklist.description: MUST be true. Every contract item must be checked off with evidence.

handoffRequirements.description: Hard requirements for a valid handoff. All four booleans MUST be true.

closeConditions.description: Conditions that trigger agent closure (COMPLETED, FAILED, STALE, REPLACED).

reason.description: The close reason this condition maps to.

antiDeceptionChecks.description: Checklist of anti-deception rules applicable to this capsule.

severity.description: P0 = integrity violation (block), P1 = quality violation (warn), P2 = advisory.

escalationTriggers.description: Conditions that trigger escalation to the Orchestrator or human operator.

triggerId.description: Unique identifier for this escalation trigger.

condition.description: Description of what triggers the escalation.

assignedBy.description: The agentId of the Orchestrator who created this capsule.

contractVersion.description: Semantic version of the capsule contract. Capsule validation fails if consumer expects a different version.
